shared_elements: linear/geometric patterning on the body or field
justification: The main shared content is only broad: each has an anthropomorphic central presence with some circular and linear motifs. The biggest difference is that A shows a detailed profile, winged bird-headed figure holding objects among plant/rosette forms, while B shows a highly schematic frontal figure or torso with geometric facial/body markings and no comparable wings, plants, held objects, or narrative interaction.
